{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cozy merino wool sweater, relaxed fit, thigh-length hem, heather oatmeal color (#D7CCC8), soft knit fabric.
Water-resistant technical jacket, streamlined cut, hip-length, stormy slate color (#455A64), matte synthetic shell fabric.
Chelsea boots made of treated leather, ankle-high shaft, chestnut brown color (#5D4037), rubber-wrapped sole fabric.
This outfit works perfectly because the warm wool sweater provides essential insulation against the frost and snow, while the water-resistant jacket keeps you dry if precipitation occurs during your walk. The relaxed yet neat silhouette honors the "everyday" dress code without sacrificing comfort for a twenty-minute stroll on a salted road. Finally, the earthy tones of oatmeal and chestnut brown create a sophisticated morning look that feels both protective and stylish in crisp autumn daylight."}
